data.body:
RCA (Phase 1, /rebar-debug) — CONFIRMED root cause with runtime proof.

MECHANISM: the default (human) 'rebar show' arm attaches plan_review_health to the rendered dict (src/rebar/_engine_support/reads_cli.py:206). For a ticket with a certified plan-review attestation, plan_review_health (src/rebar/audit/read.py:81) -> attest.compute_validity (attest.py:445) -> derive_plan_material_pin_health -> pin_health.derive_health (pin_health.py:175), which per plan-material pin calls fingerprint() -> current_material_fingerprint_impl -> current_plan_context -> live_material_children (relation_snapshot.py:299) -> _reads.list_tickets(parent=<pin>) -> reads.list_states -> reduce_all_tickets — a FULL-STORE reduction (every ticket's event log parsed) per pin, because list has no per-parent index. For every pin whose fingerprint mismatches, _legacy_material_ok (attest.py:679-712, bug-96d1 grandfather) recomputes the fingerprint under THREE more legacy generations = 3 more full-store scans each.

QUANTIFIED (discriminating experiment, read-only instrumented run on the real store, 5247 tickets): epic 2ddd-b523-06da-4b4a carries 23 plan-material pins, 22 currently stale (children in active flux). Monkeypatch-counted: plan_review_health alone = 89 full-store scans and 466,983 single-ticket reduces, wall 745.2s UNLOADED-ish (ambient load). Arithmetic check: 23 pins x 1 + 22 stale x 3 legacy = 89; 89 x 5247 = 466,983 — EXACT match. bare show_state = 0.0s, 0 scans. rebar list --parent (same epic, same window) = 1 full-store scan, 9.1s. Asymmetry show:list = 89:1 scans — fully explains 'list completes in ~67s under load, show produces zero output >200s' (89 scans x tens of seconds under 20-writer contention = hours).

RUNTIME ORACLE: faulthandler periodic stacks (20s interval) on a live stalled 'rebar show airborne-wellloved-kingfisher' — every dump inside compute_validity -> derive_health -> _legacy_material_ok/current_material_fingerprint_impl -> live_material_children -> list_tickets -> reduce_all_tickets. macOS 'sample' of the stalled PID: CPU-bound in __open/stat/getdirentries64/scanstring_unicode (file scan + JSON parse churn). Process state R with growing CPU time throughout.

RIVALS REJECTED: (a) lock contention/blocked-on-write-lock — rejected: process runnable, CPU time growing, no lock-acquisition frame in any of 5+ stack dumps; (b) inbound_deps corpus scan — never appeared in stacks; bounded at ~1 scan; (c) enrich-drain gate as the stall driver — never in the show stacks; it is a SEPARATE bounded symptom: maybe_drain runs on the store WRITE path (event_append.py:398, push.py:594) and pending_enrichment's O(1) gate marker (queue.py:414, task 4144-75d3) is cleared by EVERY append, so under sustained multi-writer load the fast path never engages and every write pays a full queue scan (0.3-3.6s observed, warning at enrich_drain.py:385 is by-design observability, 'budget is an observed target, not a cutoff').

DEFECT LEGITIMACY: defect (regression on the show surface). current_material_fingerprint_impl's own contract says 'a LIGHT read (the ticket + its child ids only — no full child fetch, no LLM)' (relation_snapshot.py docstring) — the implementation is O(full store) per call; and show==list==search read parity (test_reducer_single_source contract) is violated by show carrying an O(89 x store) derivation.

ATTRIBUTION (--caused-by): cb6b-24b4-1056-4ee6, commit dcf41e78234 (2026-07-22, 'cb6b: surface derived plan-review health') — the change that wired the gate-priced pin derivation into the default 'rebar show' render (reads_cli.py; symbol absent at dcf41e78234^). Before it, show never ran the derivation and could not stall; a cb6b reviewer could plausibly have caught 'this runs O(pins) full-store scans on every human show'. Date test passes (predates the report; no later change to that wiring). CONTRIBUTING (not the origin of the show regression): 75de-02b0-d454-410b (0c1d0c18416, per-pin full-store fingerprint in the gate), 96d1 grandfather (357d8f6457a, x4 multiplier on stale pins), b7a2 (20ce87809f8, carrier). Divergence note: whole-file blame on the hot loop would name the 96d1/b7a2 commits — considered and rejected: they only scaled a cost that cb6b had already put on the read path.
